info.title: Floodcaster Unified Mobile Hazard API
info.description: PROPOSED single mobile-facing contract for property context, certified flood determinations, field observations, and location-relative hazards. Flood, severe weather, tropical cyclone, wildfire, coastal, and winter-weather records use one nearby-hazards operation and one common authority/provenance envelope. Hazard-family details remain typed and source-attributed; an official alert, a source observation, a forecast, a historical record, a Floodcaster analysis, and a user field observation are never interchangeable. Existing non-live contractor operations and /mobile/v1 paths remain stable. A route appearing here does not assert that it is deployed.

200.description: Layer index (feature counts, sizes, sha256) from the corpus manifest

get.summary: Stream one corpus flood layer as GeoJSON
get.description: Presentation/test data only; layer content is never authorization or an authoritative area-of-interest boundary. Bytes match the sha256 pinned in the layer index. flood-stress-3x is the performance probe input.

get.summary: Download the offline map pack binary
get.description: PMTiles archive for the corpus test area. The client verifies the downloaded bytes against content_sha256 from the bootstrap map_pack manifest before marking the pack available offline. Presentation data only; pack membership is never authorization.

post.summary: Submit one durable client operation for server adjudication
post.description: Requires a valid session token. X-Floodcaster-Mock-Scenario is accepted only by the TEST_ONLY mock and selects applied, verify-required, rejected, replay, or collision. X-Floodcaster-Mock-Session-State: expired forces an expired-session response regardless of token age.

200.description: Acknowledged operation with separate domain outcome

401.description: Transport-layer authentication failure (AUTH_REQUIRED or AUTH_EXPIRED). Not a domain outcome; queued client work must survive it unchanged.

409.description: Stable operation ID was reused with a different payload

get.summary: Get all supported hazards near a location
get.description: Single bounded location query for flood, severe weather, tropical cyclone, wildfire, coastal, winter-weather, and other source-attributed hazards. TEST_ONLY fixtures and live sources return the same schema. Incomplete or unavailable sources are reported explicitly in provenance and are never treated as an evaluated absence.

agedEffectivePanel.summary: Madison, WI — aged effective panel, no revisions
agedEffectivePanel.description: The commercially load-bearing case. Zone X, not in an SFHA, no base flood elevation — and a governing panel that became effective on 2009-01-02. Under 0.3.0 this response was indistinguishable from one backed by a panel issued last quarter.

unifiedHazardFamilies.description: TEST_ONLY contract example. It demonstrates one endpoint and preserves source authority: NASA FIRMS is a source observation, not an official fire alert.

HazardSourceUnavailable.description: A required upstream source is unavailable and the operation cannot answer safely

layer_class.description: Semantic class of the layer, not a style hint. The POC corpus serves only HAZARD layers; the full enum is reserved so future layer types extend the index without a contract break. Clients must render unknown classes generically rather than failing.

GeoJsonGeometry.description: RFC 7946 geometry in WGS 84, or null when the authority supplies no geometry

release_id.description: Exact release selected for this query

status.description: ACTIVE means the query used reconciled, activated reference releases. NOT_READY includes an incomplete or DRAFT load and must never be presented as authoritative.

agency.description: Issuing or observing organization, for example NWS, NOAA, NHC, FEMA, NASA, NIFC, or a named state/local authority.

system.description: Namespaced source system or dataset, for example NWS_ALERTS, NHC_ADVISORY_GIS, NWM_FIM, NASA_FIRMS, or FEMA_NFHL.

content_digest.description: Digest of the retained source record or source bundle when available.

hazard_id.description: Namespaced stable identifier, for example nws:alert:<id>

geometry.description: Source geometry. Null is explicit when the provider record has no usable geometry.

source_id.description: Panel identifier where one was resolved, otherwise the service endpoint

LomrContext.description: Letters of Map Revision intersecting the query point. A LOMR effective after the panel effective date means the panel on file has been officially revised and is no longer the whole answer.

evaluation.description: EVALUATED: the revision layer answered and returned revisions. ABSENT_EVALUATED: it answered and there are none. NOT_EVALUATED: it did not answer; counts are null, never zero.

FirmCurrencyAssessment.description: Floodcaster's derived vintage classification. It is an assertion about the age and revision state of the map, NOT about legal validity. An effective panel remains legally effective regardless of this value; the regulatory question belongs to the community and the lender.

as_of.description: Evaluation date. Age is relative to this, not to read time.

policy_id.description: Versioned classification policy. Changing a threshold requires a new policy_id so a stored determination replays to the same answer.

derived.description: Always true. No authority publishes this field.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the ordered rule that produced the classification

FirmMapContext.title: FIRM panel currency context
FirmMapContext.description: The vintage and revision state of the FEMA FIRM panel governing the query point. Sourced from the NFHL FIRM Panel layer (S_FIRM_Pan) and the LOMR layer (S_LOMR). Panel identity and dates are transcribed from FEMA; every computed field is named in derived_fields.

evaluation.description: EVALUATED: a governing panel was resolved. ABSENT_EVALUATED: the authority answered and no panel covers this point. NOT_EVALUATED: the authority did not answer. NOT_EVALUATED must never be presented as an absence of flood hazard.

panel_type.description: FEMA PANEL_TYP verbatim. Deliberately not an enum: FEMA extends this domain, and clients must render an unrecognised value generically rather than fail.

effective_date.description: FEMA EFF_DATE, the date the panel became effective

preliminary_date.description: FEMA PRE_DATE. Non-null means a revision is in flight.

age_days.description: DERIVED. Whole days from effective_date to currency_assessment.as_of.

regulatory_status.description: DERIVED. FEMA publishes no single status field.

source_citation.description: FEMA SOURCE_CIT, the study backing the panel

derived_fields.description: Every field in this object computed rather than transcribed

HazardRecordKind.description: Authority-preserving class. Clients must display these classes distinctly and must not promote one class into another.

unit.description: Explicit unit such as km, m, kt, hPa, mm, percent, or count. Null only for dimensionless or textual values.

source_field.description: Original provider field used for this metric, when applicable.

WildfireHazardDetails.description: Fire detections, perimeters, incidents, and official alerts retain their original evidence class; a satellite hotspot is not an official evacuation alert.

x-contract-invariants: OFFICIAL_ALERT is reserved for a record issued as an alert by the named source authority.
A satellite fire hotspot, model output, field observation, or Floodcaster analysis MUST NOT be presented as an official alert.
An empty evaluated result MUST remain distinct from NOT_READY, NOT_COVERED, and SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.
The mobile client MUST NOT convert hazard context or a field observation into a certified Floodcaster determination.
